title: ReportAiUsageMeResultV2
description: report.ai-usage-me-result@2: the AI usage of one person (plan L41 R1). GET /api/v1/me/ai/usage answers for the person their session names and nobody else: the rows of one group (day, week, month, provider, model, surface or paid_by), the totals, what each way of paying cost, two or three plain lines worked out from the numbers, and the source that answered (raw records, the roll-ups, or both). v2 replaces v1's `usage` array and its `input`/`output`/`reasoning`/`cache_read`/`cache_write`/`list_cost_usd`/`cache_saved_usd` names with `rows` and the names the route answers: `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cached_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`, `cost_usd` and `saved_usd`. The route answers 401 signed out; the subject is the session's, never the query.

group.description: The bucket the rows are grouped by; a person may ask for any of the seven.

rows.description: One row per bucket, sorted by key. Empty when the window has no calls.

key.description: The bucket's key: a day (YYYY-MM-DD), a week (its Monday), a month (YYYY-MM), a provider, a model, a surface or a payer; 'unknown' when the record has no such value.

cached_tokens.description: The input tokens read from a provider cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: The input tokens written to a provider cache.

cost_usd.description: What the tokens cost at list prices.

saved_usd.description: What the cache saved against the plain input price.

by_paid_by.description: What each way of paying cost over the same window; a payer with no calls is absent.

insights.description: Two or three plain lines worked out from the numbers, one when the window has no calls; never an AI call.

source.description: Which tables answered: raw records inside the 90-day retention, the roll-ups beyond it, or both.
